messages:
maria: ops-bot alerted that some APAC edge nodes can't reach keystore (KMS) — GPU instances stuck provisioning. anyone seeing this?
ops-bot: [ALERT] keystore-egress-failure apac-edge-1 1726161616 svc-keystore 503 NAT_CONNTRACK=exceeded
jon: seeing ~15% of warm-pool nodes failing to attach, ramping fallback to hosted capacity. costwise will add ~2.8k/day if we keep this for 6hr
sunil: digging into logs — conntrack saturation on nat-1: 'nf_conntrack: table full' and a lot of TIME_WAIT entries from SNATed privatelink IPs
anya: we rolled a firewall tighten 2h ago to block broad outbound ranges; that may have grabbed privatelink SNAT addresses by accident
maria: if that's it can we open a temporary exception for the privatelink/SNAT range (10.0.128.0/22) to keystore? need hotfix so warm-pool can attach
sec-eng: confirmed we pushed a deny for 10.0.128.0/22 -> internet egress to reduce blast radius. looks like SNAT caused privatelink egress to match that rule. i'll rollback the deny in 5 unless someone objects
jon: note on cost: current fallback to hosted adds ~2.8k/day and adds throttling risk for customer traffic. also churn on nodes will push up spot reclaim overhead
sunil: quick mitigation: increase conntrack table so NAT doesn't drop new flows while we fix firewall. sysctl we plan to run: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=524288`
anya: also recommend adding explicit allow for the keystore privatelink IPs in the FW with a comment referencing this thread (INC-1726161616) so future denies don't hit them
maria: proposed action: (1) rollback deny on 10.0.128.0/22 -> keystore privatelink (2) bump nf_conntrack_max -> monitor attach rate (3) follow-up RFC to avoid SNAT-dependent rules
jon: step 2 longer plan = route keystore egress from edge via internal edge-keystore-proxy so we don't blow nat conntrack with ephemeral flows. estimated 90m to validate and ship
ops-bot: deploy started: firewall rollback initiated by sec-eng @1726161705
sec-eng: rollback completed @1726161720 — 10.0.128.0/22 reopened to privatelink keystore (rule id fw-9876 removed)
sunil: bumped nf_conntrack_max to 524288 at 1726161740. immediate conntrack util went from 95% -> 12%
jon: warm-pool attach success back up to 98% within 5m :tada:
anya: i'll open RFC and a short runbook: avoid rules that match SNAT ranges, prefer principal-based allowlists or privatelink-specific tags. cc @maria @jon @sec-eng
maria: please collect audit event IDs for the rollback and conntrack change and tag the incident board. if this crosses 4hr impact we do a full postmortem
jon: filing incident INC-1726161616 and linking logs/graphs
maria: closing here for now. will keep monitoring for 2 hours and reopen if anything flares
ops-bot: monitor heartbeat OK @1726162050
